name: Paud

facts.text: Paud: level 39, a treant body (model 946, size 125), faction The Watcher, at about 412,000/320,600 below the rows of vigilant ones; respawn 600 seconds.
Living Server lore: Paud and Regan as the eldest Watchers, the only two who remember what the rows were set to watch for.

story:
Paud is one of the two eldest Watchers of Vigilant Rock, and the larger, a great treant standing a little below the rows of the vigilant ones with Regan beside him. The Necht folk say the Watchers were set on the shelf before there were Sylvan to see it done, to watch the sea for whatever might come out of it, and that Paud and Regan are the only two who still remember what that was.

Paud does not say. When the realm's companies come down the shelf, he turns his eyes on them slowly, the way he turned them on Orlaith of Necht when she asked, and then back to the water, and if they come closer he takes it as the thing he was set to watch for, and does what he was never able to do when the Fomorians came ashore. The Necht fishers say that is the saddest thing on the rock: that the Watchers learned to act only after it was too late, and now act against the wrong people.
legend: Paud (39) is a big treant of the Watcher faction below the vigilant-one rows (about 412k/321k), right beside Regan (38). They stand together, so expect both. Treant hits are slow and heavy. 10-minute respawn. Killing Watchers costs faction with the vigilant ones. Pull them to the open shelf, away from the rows, or the vigilant ones (36-42) on the slope above join in. Mel the trading dervish wants Watcher leaves; that kill task costs the same faction.

aggro: (the great trunk turns its eyes from the sea)
You came out of the water. You came out of the water.
slay: (the treant turns back to the water)
